findings.label: Voice is wired on one path only
findings.where: src/pages/Chat/Chat.jsx:286 (only speak() call site), src/pages/Chat/Chat.jsx:330 (fallback reply)
findings.finding: The models:chat fallback adds its reply with no speak() attempt and no voiceSilent flag, so VOICE ON is silent with no explanation whenever the conversation path is unavailable (tier 4-5 capability denial, transport failure, older preload). Same defect class as iteration 2 finding 5, in the path that fix did not reach. Either speak on the fallback reply too, or say on the bubble that the fallback does not speak.

findings.label: Per-turn sensitivity gate has no producer
findings.where: electron/ipc/modelRouter.cjs:514 default, src/pages/Chat/Chat.jsx:280 passes neither sensitive nor classification
findings.finding: No call site sets sensitive, so every turn today is classified public and crosses to a cloud model, a holdings question included. Recorded, not hidden: CONVERSATION.md section 11.5 states it with three options and recommends a per-turn 'keep this one local' control as its own tranche. Master's decision, not a review-loop change.

findings.label: Cheapest-sufficient picks ministral-3:8b, not the brief's gemma4:31b
findings.finding: Across the full fourteen keyed cloud rows the table's declared cheapest-sufficient rule selects ministral-3:8b. The brief's gemma4:31b IS asserted as the real selection on a local-plus-cloud candidate pair in both orders, so requirement 4's intent is covered; preferring the largest row within budget would be a new role flag (preferLargest) and a behaviour change. Raised twice, correctly not taken.

findings.label: Anti-trimming guard bans .slice( across the whole module
findings.where: scripts/verifyConversation.cjs, row 'and the module still contains no trimming of the retained list'
findings.finding: The row asserts !/\.slice\(/ over all of electron/lib/conversationRole.cjs, so any future legitimate .slice( in that file fails red under a label about the retained list. Narrow the guard to the retained list if the row is kept.

findings.label: retained is correct because the closure is stale
findings.finding: The retained window reads the messages value captured at render, which is why master's new turn is not sent twice (it travels separately as text). A refactor to a ref or a fresh store read would duplicate the turn silently. Worth one line of comment at the call site.
